g.text: Question: add the three missing arrowheads, label D and B, and complete the six blank property cells.
Check water balance at every box. Explain which transfers change the combined atm + ocn inventories.
Units: DIC in mol C/kg; TA in mol equivalents/kg. Carbon fluxes in Tmol C/yr; TA fluxes in Tmol equivalents/yr.
Workbook: data/Boudreau_2010/model_definition.xlsx. Reservoir tables own geometry, T/S/P and initial states; restart replaces states.
Teaching adaptation of the ESBMTK Boudreau benchmark (Wortmann et al., 2025, Fig. 3). See companion notes for transport units and source aliases.
